title: Two Sum
description: Given an sequence of integers arr and an integer goal, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to goal. Note: With n up to 100000, O(n²) solutions may not pass. Furthermore, after the main computation, find GCD is required.
input_format:
First line: size (1 ≤ size ≤ 100)
Second line: size space-separated integers
Third line: goal integer
